name: hud_ui_load_game_dialog_destructor
description: HudUiLoadGameDialog::Destructor destroys the load primary action button, frees the save-file entry vector, destroys nine list item panels, the game-name input, shared save/load controls, and finally the HUD background base.
known_limits: Binary Ninja reconstruction is limited by explicit MSVC destructor EH scaffolding in the decompiler.
The smoke covers constructed child widgets and vector cleanup with an allocated file-entry buffer; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD save/load dialog pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x434df0 validates the primary action button destructor-core call, operator delete on fileEntries.begin followed by vector clear, reverse destruction of nine HudUiSaveLoadListItem panels, game-name input destruction, previous/next/back/delete control destructor-core calls, and final HudUiBackground::Destructor.

The native smoke constructs the owned child widgets, allocates fileEntries storage, calls Destructor, and validates vector clearing plus final demotion states for the background, buttons, list item panels, and game-name input buffer.
